entries.title: T3 Code Nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5151 (856b105fa23f)
entries.note: v0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5151 · 67 changes from 25 contributors Background browser previews. Agents can take screenshots and interact with previews while T3 Code is hidden, minimized, or covered. Agent message delivery. Messages from other agents can steer a running turn without waiting behind a queued message. Web startup. T3 Code starts in browsers where WebAssembly is disabled. Open links on macOS. Links open a T3 Code window when the app is running without one. Plus 51 more bug fixes and performance improvements. entries.title: T3 Code Nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5138 (1368854828e2)
entries.note: v0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5138 · 83 changes from 27 contributors Events for outside agents. ChatGPT and other compatible agents can now receive T3 Code events. Faster worktree launches. New worktree threads start sooner by generating branch names while the worktree is created. Less repository slowdown. T3 Code's Git operations no longer trigger automatic maintenance that can tie up large repositories. Queued messages preserved. Messages remain visible after a server restart cancels a turn that had already started. Background work when settling. Settling a thread no longer stops background agents and commands that its agent is waiting on. Plus 69 more bug fixes and performance improvements. Full changelog What's Changed feat(server): outside agents receive milestones by MCP Events webhooks by @juliusmarminge in #41141 fix(antigravity): recognize attachments with MIME parameters by @Lucenx9

entries.title: T3 Code Nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5124 (2808e878de91)
entries.note: v0.1.12-nightly.20261123.5124 · 41 changes from 20 contributors Workflows (Labs). Run workflows that coordinate agents, code, events, and approvals, and inspect and control them in the app. Turn them on in Settings → Labs. Multiple Linear accounts. Connect multiple Linear accounts and use the appropriate account for each project. Agent feedback. Turn on feedback so agents can report T3 Code problems they encounter. Simulator app switcher. Double-tap Home in the simulator to open the app switcher. Agent events. Outside agents can poll or stream events when things happen in T3 Code, through the MCP Events extension (beta), instead of repeatedly checking thread lists. Large file previews. Open large files in full without freezing the file preview. Faster new threads. New thread drafts open immediately, even when the server is busy. Plus 30 more bug fixes. T3 Code Nightly 0.1.12-nightly.20261122.5111 (024dba275d9e)
entries.note: v0.1.12-nightly.20261122.5111 · 30 changes from 10 contributors Multi-file diffs. Open diff now shows every file in a multi-file Codex patch. Mixed-content paste. Pasting a message with text and a picture now keeps both. Queued attachments. Edit a queued message without losing its image or file attachment chips. Pull request checks. Agents watching a pull request can recognize checks that already passed instead of waiting indefinitely. Notebook outputs. Saved HTML outputs now appear when you scroll them into view. Plus 24 more bug fixes and performance improvements.
